literal: Of-flood like sorrow wisdom-possessor by-mind to-think will-perish.
translation: Sorrow that seems as vast as a flood will vanish the moment a wise man sizes it up in his mind.
modern: வெள்ளம் போலப் பெருகி வரும் துன்பமும், அறிவுடையவன் தன் உள்ளத்தால் அதன் தன்மையை நினைத்த அளவிலேயே அழிந்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet illustrates how a wise person handles overwhelming difficulties. Trouble may appear as vast and unstoppable as a flood. However, a person equipped with wisdom does not panic. The moment he calmly evaluates the situation in his mind, the seemingly insurmountable sorrow loses its power and perishes. The contrast between the massive physical flood and the simple mental act of thinking highlights the supreme power of a clear mind over external adversity.
